description: A sheer, acoustically reverberant ironstone rift valley spanned by colossal brass viaducts, rhythmic piston foundries, and the clockwork cloisters of the Iron Choir.

districts.name: Grand Gantry of the Seventh Chime
districts.flavor: Suspended bronze acoustic bridges that vibrate in four-four martial cadence high above the thunderous forge flues.

districts.name: The Clockwork Proving Floor
districts.flavor: An interlocking gear-plated testing ground where Choir duelists calibrate armor and test mechanical synergy.

districts.name: Bell-Spire of Saint Automaton
districts.flavor: The sacred tower housing the Great Metronome whose steady sweep synchronizes all acoustic automata in the canyon.

districts.name: The Harmonic Dynamo Vaults
districts.flavor: Spinning copper gyro-turbines that capture static discharges from canyon storms to refine pure resonance cores.

npcs.name: Master Artificer Vance
npcs.title: Grand Machinist of the Seventh Chime

dialogue.greeting: Careful where you place your boots, initiate. Every plate on this floor is balanced to the ounce.
dialogue.friendly: Your deck shows signs of sound calibration. Aether flows true when resistance is eliminated.
dialogue.bonded: Take this harmonic damper. In the final archive, raw starweave frequencies will shatter unshielded glass.
dialogue.victory: Superb cadence! Your timing broke through my reinforced bulwark.
dialogue.defeat: Steel does not yield to haste. Tighten your deck's defensive curve.

dialogue.greeting: Listen closely. If the tick falters by half a second, the whole canyon slips out of tempo.
dialogue.friendly: The Choir sings not out of pride, but precision. Have you calibrated your Relics?
dialogue.bonded: You understand the rhythm now. When you face the Astral Archive, keep our cadence in your mind.
dialogue.victory: A sharp sequence! You struck between the second and third stroke.
dialogue.defeat: You rushed your hand. The bell dictates the pace, duelist.

quests.title: Act 3: The Cadence of the Gantry
quests.objective: Defeat Master Artificer Vance on the Clockwork Proving Floor using a legal 40-card deck.

quests.title: Synchronizing the Bell-Spire
quests.objective: Overcome the automated defense gauntlet in the Bell-Spire to secure the resonance tuning fork.
